### Repository Dropdown

The top-right repository selector (`AppShell.jsx`) and the hero-panel selector in `WorkspaceHub.jsx` both display names from the `repositories` state. The `backend/services/codeIndexer.js` is the authoritative source — it now serves `codescope-backend` and `codescope-frontend`. The frontend `AnalysisContext.jsx` fallback initial data was already correct and now matches.

### localStorage Key Rename

Keys `impactiq_token`, `impactiq_user`, and `impactiq_sidebar_expanded` were renamed to `codescope_token`, `codescope_user`, and `codescope_sidebar_expanded` respectively. These keys are consistent across all four files that reference them (`AuthContext.jsx`, `SidebarContext.jsx`, `WorkspaceHub.jsx`, `api.js`). This change will clear any previously stored sessions on first load after deployment — users will need to log in again once.
